svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-19
svg.desc: JSON role configuration and config/build cleanup.
svg.text: 2026-07-19 - JSON role configuration and cleanup
main | 4 commits: e9e790b, ccaf478, 892aac8, 204b2f7
Daily job
Replace a hard-coded role asset with runtime role data and clean config/build ownership.
Role schema, loaders, UI/load-slot consumers, config paths, build dependency, and developer plugin tracking changed.
BEFORE
Role behavior tied to assets
Role data was hard-coded or asset-bound.
Config tables lived in scattered paths.
Developer plugin files were tracked.
Changing a role required code/content edits.
AFTER
RoleConfig.json is the runtime source
RoleInfo structures and JSON helpers feed character, player, GameMode, and load-screen code.
Item and monster tables move under Content/Config.
ModelViewViewModel dependency supports load-slot role assignment.
RiderLink files are removed and Plugins/Developer is ignored.
Guard: RoleConfig.json selects runtime role data; DA_RoleInfo is no longer the owner.
Important guard
Start role changes in RoleConfig.json.
Keep config consumers aligned after moves;
do not restore the old asset source by habit.
Validation / newcomer path
Trace RoleConfig.json -> RoleInfo -> runtime consumers.
Then inspect Content/Config and build dependency changes.
The monthly July map holds the full diff context.
